description: routing_mailer.rs glob_matches() strips the '*.' prefix and checks domain.ends_with('.suffix'). This means '*.example.com' matches 'a.b.example.com' as well as 'mail.example.com'. Per RFC 1034 §4.3.3, '*' in a wildcard label matches exactly one DNS label — so '*.example.com' should match 'mail.example.com' but NOT 'deep.sub.example.com'. The fix in commit 573763b removed the bare-domain match (correct) but did not restrict to single-label. Fix: after ends_with check, also verify that the part before the suffix contains no '.'. The test added in 573763b does not cover the multi-level subdomain case. Add: assert!(!glob_matches("*.example.com", "deep.sub.example.com")).
title: smtp: glob_matches *.example.com incorrectly matches deep.sub.example.com (multi-label wildcard)
